subject: Mobile Development
subcategory: Famous Apps That Changed the World
title: ChatGPT: AI in Your Pocket
description: A micro-lesson that makes ChatGPT: AI in Your Pocket usable.

hook.text: ChatGPT reached 100 million users in two months — the fastest-growing app in history.

buildup.text: OpenAI's chatbot could answer questions, write essays, code, and hold conversations.

discovery.text: The mobile app brought AI capabilities to anyone with a phone, not just tech workers.

twist.text: Schools, businesses, and entire industries scrambled to adapt as AI became suddenly accessible.

climax.text: ChatGPT marked the moment AI left the lab and became a tool for ordinary people.

punchline.text: AI went from research paper to everyone's phone.

quiz.question: How fast did ChatGPT reach 100 million users?
